field_evidence.dataset_title: Primary fires in schools in London
field_evidence.description: Primary fires in nursery, infant/primary and secondary schools attended by LFB; records include incident date/time, school/address/postcode, borough/ward, fire cause and fire-safety-system fields.
field_evidence.published_resource: Fires in schools 2013 to 2018 - to end August 2018

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade 'Primary fires in schools in London' dataset. Its incident records include school/address/postcode and borough/ward location, and the published resource covers Jan 2013 through Aug 2018. This batch binds the verified Campden ward (E05009390) to that unused official ward-bearing source window; extraction of Campden rows, geometry and parcel join is deferred to local OpenCode.
